message: missing frame-ancestors directive; clickjacking protection relies solely on X-Frame-Options
notes: Often skipped or weakened (e.g. 'unsafe-inline'/'unsafe-eval') because a strict policy requires allowlisting every script and style source across the whole site; one new third-party script, ad, or inline style can break the page unless CSP is updated in lockstep.
remediation: Remove 'unsafe-inline'/'unsafe-eval'; set a restrictive default-src; add frame-ancestors 'none' or 'self'.
